[[File:ArtooFusionWelder-ROTS.jpg|thumb|right|200px|R2-D2's fusion welder employed against a buzz droid]]
'''Fusion welders''' or '''fusion-welder''' were tools carried by [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] had a fusion-welder installed in his dome, which he employed against a [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Pistoeka sabotage droid]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].
